name: Holy Roman Empire
aliases: Holy Roman Empire of the German Nation

flag.description: A gold field with a black double-headed eagle, each head surrounded by a halo, with red beaks, tongues and talons.
flag.symbolism: Black and gold were the imperial colours, and the double-headed eagle became the emblem of the emperor in the 15th century, while a single-headed eagle stood for the King of the Romans.

hook: The Holy Roman Empire's banner is a black two-headed eagle with haloes on gold; Albania's black two-headed eagle sits on red, and Prussia's single-headed eagle on white.
trivia: Voltaire quipped that the Holy Roman Empire was "neither holy, nor Roman, nor an empire".
The empire was dissolved in 1806, when Francis II laid down the crown after Napoleon's victories; he continued to reign as Emperor of Austria.
